scripts.watch: cd api && bun run --watch src/server.ts & cd web && bun run --watch start
scripts.migrate:up: docker-compose exec directus npx directus database migrate:up
scripts.migrate:down: docker-compose exec directus npx directus database migrate:down
scripts.republish: cd common && npm run unpublish && npm publish && cd ../Kazaswap && npm upgrade @kazaswap/common && cd ..
